phrase.en: They expect rain tomorrow, so we'll probably stay in.
phrase.ru: Завтра обещают дождь, так что мы, наверное, останемся дома.
phrase.es: Mañana esperan lluvia, así que probablemente nos quedaremos en casa.

text.ru: probably с will — после will, а с won't — перед ним: We'll probably stay. We probably won't go. weather неисчисляемое: nice weather, без a.
text.en: With will, probably goes after it; with won’t, before it: We’ll probably stay. We probably won’t go. weather is uncountable: nice weather, no a.
text.es: probably: después de will y antes de won’t. weather es incontable: nice weather, sin a.

examples.en: We probably won't go to the beach.
examples.ru: Мы, наверное, не пойдём на пляж.

exercises.en: We probably won't go out today.
